title: 第一卷第9章 联手智杀火焰蟒第一卷第10章 大周传奇
content_zh:
;;
君无邪有些紧张了，这个任务对于他来说太过重要，关乎着他和月瑶的生死。
他祈祷白甲女子不是火焰蟒的对手，虽然这样有些不厚道，但也只有这样，他才有机会去完成击杀任务。
那个女子已到了山谷最深处。
岩洞内传来火焰蟒的嘶吼。
它出现了，高昂着蛇头，直接冲向了白甲女子。
轰！
大战瞬间爆发。
君无邪暗中观战，心里震惊。
那个女子骑着千灵驹，枪出如龙，每一枪都顶住了火焰蟒的攻击，两者之间厮杀得山崩地裂，坚硬的大地裂开了，乱石穿空。
凝气境的强者？
君无邪屏住呼吸，他从来没有见过这个境界的武者，今日算是看到了，实在可怕！
“没想到竟是四阶凶兽！”
山谷内，正与火焰蟒激战的女子惊讶的声音传到了君无邪耳中。
四阶？
君无邪背脊有些发凉，四阶是什么概念？那可是相当于在体内开辟出了洞天的洞天境武者！
这么看来，那个女子根本不是什么凝气境，应该是洞天境！
青阳城这样的地界，居然出现了这么一位强者。
君无邪想不通的是，这个境界的强者会在乎十万金？
轰隆！

大战场面很狂暴，将一座小山峦都崩裂了。
火焰蟒身上的火红鳞片被崩掉了许多，而那个女子的情况似乎也不怎么好，脸色有些苍白，嘴角溢出了血渍。
“不对劲，她并没有被直接攻击到，怎么会溢血……难道她本来就有内伤？”
君无邪正想着，那个女子却是在战斗中退向了谷口，火焰蟒追到谷口就停了，最终返回了岩洞。
机会来了！
君无邪眼睛一亮，有时候运气真的很重要。
他今日来到这里，似乎就注定了有些事可成。
他没有犹豫，迅速向着女子所在的方向奔去。
谷口，女子正在盘坐着调息疗伤，察觉到有人靠近，睁开眼眸。
她微微一怔，来人竟然是个后天境的武者。
可这个后天境的武者，居然修炼出了极境？
content_en:
;;
Jun Wuxie was a little nervous. This task was too important for him and related to the life and death of him and Yue Yao.
He prayed that the white-armored woman would not be a match for the flame python. Although this was a bit unkind, only in this way could he have a chance to complete the killing mission.
The woman has reached the deepest part of the valley.
The roar of the flame python came from the cave.
It appeared, holding its head high, and rushed directly towards the woman in white armor.
boom!
The war broke out instantly.
Jun Wuxie watched the battle secretly, feeling shocked.
The woman was riding a Thousand Spirit Horse, and her spear was like a dragon. Every shot withstood the attack of the flame python. The two fought so hard that the mountains collapsed, the hard earth cracked, and rocks penetrated the sky.
A strong man in the Qi Condensation Realm?
Jun Wuxie held his breath. He had never seen a warrior in this realm before, but he saw it today. It was really scary!
"I didn't expect it to be a fourth-level ferocious beast!"
In the valley, the surprised voice of the woman who was fighting fiercely with the flame python reached Jun Wuxie's ears.
Fourth level?
Jun Wuxie felt a chill running down his spine. What is the concept of the fourth level? That is equivalent to a Dongtian realm warrior who has opened up a cave in his body!
From this point of view, that woman is not in the Qi Condensation Realm at all, but should be in the Cave Heaven Realm!
In a place like Qingyang City, such a strong man actually appeared.
What Jun Wuxie couldn't figure out was that a strong man in this realm would care about one hundred thousand gold?
Boom!
The battle scene was so violent that a small mountain was broken apart.
Many of the fiery red scales on the flame python's body were broken off, and the woman's condition didn't seem to be very good either. Her face was a little pale, and blood stains overflowed from the corners of her mouth.
"Something's wrong, she wasn't directly attacked, so why did she bleed... Could it be that she had internal injuries to begin with?"
Just as Jun Wuxie was thinking about it, the woman retreated towards the mouth of the valley during the battle. The flame python chased her to the mouth of the valley and stopped, finally returning to the cave.
The opportunity has come!
Jun Wuxie's eyes lit up, sometimes luck is really important.
When he came here today, it seemed that he was destined to achieve something.
He did not hesitate and quickly ran in the direction of the woman.
At the entrance of the valley, the woman was sitting cross-legged, adjusting her breathing and healing her injuries. She noticed someone approaching and opened her eyes.
She was slightly startled, the person coming turned out to be a warrior in the acquired realm.
But this Houtian realm warrior actually cultivated to the extreme realm?
